name: bug_academybugs_twitter_share_nxdomain_01
description: X/Twitter social share link on AcademyBugs.com product pages leads to a DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error.

nodes.content: Open a new Firefox browser window.

metadata.expected_result: A new, empty Firefox browser window is open and active.

nodes.content: Navigate to the 'Find Bugs' page by entering 'https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/' into the address bar and pressing Enter.

metadata.expected_result: The AcademyBugs 'Find Bugs' page (https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/) is successfully loaded and displayed.

nodes.content: On the 'Find Bugs' page, identify and click on the first available product link. For example, this might be 'DNK Yellow Shoes'.

ui_elements: First product link on the page
metadata.expected_result: The browser navigates to the product detail page for the clicked product.

nodes.content: On the product detail page, locate the social media share icon for 'X' (formerly Twitter). This is typically represented by an 'X' logo or a bird logo.

metadata.expected_result: The 'X' (Twitter) social share icon is visually identified on the page.
A new browser tab attempts to open or the current tab attempts to navigate to a Twitter sharing URL.

nodes.content: Observe the browser. Note any new tabs opened and error messages displayed. Specifically, look for a DNS error page.

metadata.expected_result: A browser error page is displayed, typically in a new tab, showing a message like 'This site can't be reached' and 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'.

nodes.content: (Optional) Open browser developer tools (e.g., by pressing F12), navigate to the 'Console' and 'Network' tabs, and look for specific error details related to DNS resolution for the Twitter domain.

metadata.expected_result: Developer tools show errors indicating a failure to resolve the domain name associated with the Twitter share link.

verification_steps: Step 1: After clicking the 'X' (Twitter) social share icon on a product page, verify that the browser displays an error page.
Step 2: Confirm the error page indicates a DNS issue, specifically showing a 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN' message (or similar, e.g., 'This site can't be reached', 'Server not found').
Step 3: Verify that the browser does not successfully navigate to a Twitter sharing interface or page.
missing_information: Specific version of Firefox browser (though the bug is likely not version-specific).
Specific Operating System version (though 'Web' implies OS independence for this type of bug).
Screenshots of the 'Find Bugs' page, product detail page, 'X' icon, and the error page, which would aid visual identification for an agent.
